Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Interface Cast<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the Java type the attribute is read as
public interface Cast<T>
Converts one model attribute between its stored form and its Java form.

Built-in casts and user casts implement this same interface. A cast may also implement CastSerializer to control serialized output and CastComparator to control dirty detection.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to share across model instances and threads, because a resolved cast is cached once per model class. A runtime failure thrown from get(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) or set(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, T, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) is wrapped by the model in an InvalidCastException, except during a dirty check, where an exception from get(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) counts the attribute as changed.

  • Method Details

    • get

      T get(Model model, String key, Object raw, Map<String,Object> attributes)
      Converts a stored value into its Java form.

      The model calls this with a null raw only when handlesNull() returns true; otherwise a null stored value reads as null without calling the cast.

      Parameters:
      model - the model that owns the attribute
      key - the attribute name
      raw - the stored value; null only when handlesNull() is true
      attributes - the live unmodifiable view of the model's raw attributes
      Returns:
      the Java value, which may be null even for a non-null raw
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the stored value cannot be converted; the model wraps it in an InvalidCastException

    • set

      Object set(Model model, String key, T value, Map<String,Object> attributes)
      Converts a Java value into its stored form.

      The result is either a single storage value written to key, or a CastColumns whose entries are written to their own columns. This mirrors Laravel, where a cast returns either a value or an array of columns. Any other value that the driver cannot store fails when the statement binds.

      Parameters:
      model - the model that owns the attribute
      key - the attribute name
      value - the Java value; null only when handlesNull() is true
      attributes - the live unmodifiable view of the model's raw attributes
      Returns:
      the storage value for key, or a CastColumns for several columns
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the value cannot be converted; the model wraps it in an InvalidCastException

    • handlesNull

      default boolean handlesNull()
      Reports whether this cast is called for null values.
      Returns:
      true if get(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) and set(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, T, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) receive null values
      Implementation Requirements:
      The default returns false, so null passes through without calling get(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, java.lang.Object, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) or set(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.Model, java.lang.String, T, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>).
